events.title: UN condemns attempted Houthi strike on Riyadh as Yemen displacement surges past 130,000
events.summary: The UN has condemned continued cross‑border attacks by Houthi forces against Saudi Arabia, including an attempted strike on the capital Riyadh, as fighting inside Yemen drives one of the country’s fastest displacement surges in years.

events.title: ‘Nowhere is safe’: UN experts detail Ukraine war’s toll and Russia’s reach beyond its borders
events.summary: UN Human Rights Council-appointed experts on Monday laid out a grim picture of the human cost of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, with a spotlight on civilians facing a third wartime winter as well as the intimidation of Russians who have fle...

events.title: ‘We are not powerless’: UN chief urges world leaders to invest in peace
events.summary: In a world facing rising conflicts, violence and divisions that are causing great suffering for millions of people, the UN chief on Monday called on world leaders and citizens to invest more in peace.

events.title: Ebola vaccine trial begins in DR Congo
events.summary: An Ebola vaccine trial is underway in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), involving frontline health workers and others involved in the response.
